newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse prices up in active second-tier.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse prices up in active second-tier.

text.p: Most prices on the Bucharest bourse gained ground on Thursday under active trading in the second-tier stocks, brokers said.
Thursday's turnover of 2.7 billion lei was slightly down from 2.9 billion on Wednesday.
Buying pressure on small-caps Foraj Sonde SA drilling company and Policolor SA dye maker, the most active on the second-tier on Thursday, sent their prices up.
"Major players rushed to snap up shares offered by small investors in Foraj and Policolor. We expect higher volumes on those stocks next week," said one trader.
Foraj gained 100 lei to close at 500 and Policolor rose 30 lei to end at 1,630.
Only three second-tier listings had no trading on Thursday against seven on Wednesday.

The two first-tier high-caps Oltchim SA chemical plant and Azomures SA fertiliser maker continued to attract inevstors' interest. Azomures inched up 130 lei to close at 1,740, while Oltchim ended 20 lei lower at 1,370.

"Despite a constant selling pressure Oltchim won't see a sharp drop," said a broker. "The (Oltchim) stocks have now support at 1,350 lei but this level is subject of changes following the 1996 financial results."

Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- rose from the previous session by 2.5 percent and 2.6 respectively. The BIG first-tier index was 1,672.7 points, 2.1 percent up on the previous session.
The VAB index is displayed on VANGUARD.
